name: @silurus/ooxml-legacy-office
description: Optional legacy Office (DOC/XLS/PPT) model sources for @silurus/ooxml
author: Yuki Yokotani <silurus.dev@gmail.com>

scripts.wasm:direct-doc: cd parser && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../src/wasm-direct-doc --out-name legacy_doc_direct --features direct-doc && node ../../../scripts/append-wasm-reinit.mjs ../src/wasm-direct-doc/legacy_doc_direct.js
scripts.wasm:direct-ppt: cd parser && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../src/wasm-direct-ppt --out-name legacy_ppt_direct --features direct-ppt && node ../../../scripts/append-wasm-reinit.mjs ../src/wasm-direct-ppt/legacy_ppt_direct.js
scripts.wasm:direct-xls: cd parser && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../src/wasm-direct-xls --out-name legacy_xls_direct --features direct-xls && node ../../../scripts/append-wasm-reinit.mjs ../src/wasm-direct-xls/legacy_xls_direct.js
scripts.build: vite build && node ../../scripts/bundle-declarations.mjs doc xls ppt
